plan.title: Reset Terms and Conditions to Default

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ as required by the case.
Provide the mandatory event title for the create flow.
Select an available RFQ template so the pricing sheet and event controls are enabled.
Add the specified product and quantity; product selection should populate its available variant.
Verify the product's automatically populated variant matches the mapped test data.
Verify the requested quantity was entered.
Choose the specified delivery location in the pricing sheet.
Confirm the selected delivery location is shown.

args.goal: on the buyer's single-stage RFQ create screen, open Terms & Conditions, edit one clause, click Reset to Default, and stop with the Terms & Conditions view showing the reset clauses

steps.note: Perform the clause edit and Reset to Default interaction that no dedicated catalog step exposes.
Confirm the Terms & Conditions view remains open after the reset interaction.
